For the best window tinting in Adelaide you can’t go past Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. Below, we list the benefits of home window tinting in Adelaide and the types of films you can choose from.

Tint a Home has been providing tinting services in Australia for five decades – since 1972. All films in our range are exclusive to us (supplied by the largest supplier of window film in the world) and are government certified by ARPANSA. We offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications, which are done by professionally trained installers. We also have an interest free payment option available.

Here are the reasons why so many people across Australia are having their home’s windows tinted and the types of films in our range you can choose from

Home Window Tinting Adelaide

One of the most popular reasons people choose home window tinting in Adelaide is for privacy. Window tinting stops those on the outside from seeing into your home during the day – no more having to close blinds or curtains to prevent prying eyes! But, there are many more benefits too.

Other benefits of house window tinting in Adelaide include:

  • More comfortable temperatures all year round (cooler in summer and warmer in winter)
  • A reduction in glare (you’ll notice reflections on screens are reduced)
  • Improving energy efficiency (window tint acts as a layer of insulation on your windows – you’ll notice a positive difference on your power bills too)
  • Protection for you and your family from harmful UV rays
  • Increased safety and security
  • A reduction in premature fading of flooring and furnishings

Our Range of Films For House Window Tinting In Adelaide

Here are the films you can choose from for home window tinting in Adelaide:

  • Solar window films
  • Privacy films
  • Safety films
  • Security films
  • Decorative films

You can choose different types of film for different areas of your home. Safety film is popular in areas such as living room sliding doors, decorative film is often used in bathrooms and privacy film can be used for windows that are street-facing or that overlook neighbours.

With our mobile window tinting Adelaide-based service, we visit your home to do an on-site measure and quote. Whilst we are on-site, we can provide recommendations on the best film to use.
